description: Path traversal and file disclosure vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49.
remediation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to 2.4.51 or later; ensure require all denied is set on cgi-bin.

description: Log4Shell: remote code execution via JNDI lookup in Apache Log4j2.
remediation: Upgrade Log4j to 2.17.1+ or remove the JndiLookup class; restrict outbound LDAP/RMI traffic.

description: Ghostcat: AJP connector file read/inclusion vulnerability in Apache Tomcat.
remediation: Upgrade Tomcat to a patched version or disable the AJP connector if unused.

description: BlueKeep: RDP remote code execution vulnerability (pre-auth) in older Windows versions.
remediation: Apply MS19 patches; disable RDP if not required; enable Network Level Authentication.

description: OpenSSH user enumeration vulnerability via crafted authentication requests.
EternalBlue: SMBv1 remote code execution vulnerability exploited by WannaCry.
remediation: Disable SMBv1; apply MS17-010; upgrade to SMBv2/3.

description: Heartbleed: OpenSSL heartbeat extension buffer over-read exposing process memory.
remediation: Upgrade OpenSSL to 1.0.1g or later; reissue TLS certificates and rotate secrets.

description: Baron Samedit: heap overflow in sudo allowing local privilege escalation to root.
Apache Range header denial-of-service vulnerability (Apache Killer).
remediation: Upgrade Apache to 2.2.20+ or limit the Range header via mod_headers.

description: SaltStack authentication bypass allowing unauthenticated remote command execution.
remediation: Upgrade Salt to 3000.2/2019.2.4 or later; restrict access to the Salt master ports.
